answer: With a Registered domain bound by attestation certificate with one identity per channel, the account is only as strong as its binding: the registered domain answers a fresh challenge, the attestation certificate is recorded, and one identity per channel keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so losing the channel means losing the identity, and fakes cannot hide behind throwaway channels. One anchor proves nothing on its own; the proof is in the whole pattern of bindings. A juniper alone is noise; a wander of verified channels is a pattern the network can trust.
